title: Smooth fibres have regular local rings
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. For every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset R$, the base-change map $\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to S\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ is smooth, and for every prime $\mathfrak Q$ of the fibre the localization $(S\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p))_{\mathfrak Q}$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme]. The residue field and fibre are understood as in [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and the regular-local conclusion is the field-smoothness criterion recorded in [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-over-field-dimension-differentials].
